one containing more, fewer, or the same tests failing for a different reason is a
fail. Consumed by tools/check-suite-signatures.cjs.
IDENTITY IS `file` + `titlePath`, NOT LINE NUMBERS. Line numbers decay on every
edit above them; the `baselineRef` field below carries the file:line form purely
so an entry can be matched against the suite-baseline drawer by eye.
REASON CLASSES, NEVER PIXEL COUNTS. apexcharts has measured 3,126 / 3,341 / 3,261
/ 3,285 / 3,384 differing pixels across five rounds; an exact-count assertion
would be permanently red.
AUTHORITY for the seven and their signatures: MemPalace drawer
drawer_havdm_testing_127a89e2ddcdeb101452523a (HAVDM suite baseline + failure
signatures + flake ledger). NOTHING HERE IS A LICENCE TO RE-BASELINE: retiring an
entry needs a cause and the owner's authorisation.
`reasonClassVerified` records whether the class was read from an actual Playwright
JSON report in this repository, or inferred from the drawer's prose description.
The first green visual CI run is what converts the `false` entries.

⭐ 2026-08-14: the visual tier was MEASURED on ubuntu-latest (run 31802864528). 12 of 19 passed against the WSL2-generated -linux baselines, 1 skipped, and the 6 failures were EXACTLY this manifest's visual set, reason classes included. GitHub's Ubuntu therefore renders like the maintainer's WSL2+Xvfb box for these snapshots, and NO Docker image is required. Nothing was re-baselined to achieve this.
⚠⚠ 2026-08-15, AFTER CODEX ROUND-1 FINDINGS M1 AND M2. This manifest previously
held ONLY expectedFailures, and the gate counted SKIPPED tests toward its size
floor. Measured: a report with 560 of 561 outcomes skipped exited 0, and a newly
flaky regression exited 0. A floor over IDENTITIES is not evidence of EXECUTION.
Two more baselines now exist and the floor counts executed outcomes only.
expectedSkips — read from the real reports of run 31802864528, not typed. A skip
that is not baselined FAILS, and a baselined skip that did not occur FAILS (it
either started running, which is good news needing a manifest update, or its
identity moved).
expectedFlaky — the watched-flake ledger from drawer
drawer_havdm_testing_127a89e2ddcdeb101452523a. It holds TEN entries; ANY OTHER
flaky identity FAILS the run. The FIRST EIGHT are the original ledger, resolved
from prose spec:line to real identities via `--list` on 2026-08-15 (all eight
resolved, so the ledger's line numbers were still accurate). Entries NINE and TEN
were added the same day under the owner's ruling below. ⚠ Do not read "eight"
anywhere as the current size — that was the count before 2026-08-15.
⚠⚠ 2026-08-15, THE OWNER'S RULING. Round 1 left five observations
deliberately unbaselined, because re-baselining needs a cause AND the owner's
authorisation and only the first was present. THE OWNER GAVE THAT
AUTHORISATION ON 2026-08-15, so the ledger is now TEN, not eight, and the
behavioural tier expects FOUR failures, not one. Every one of the five entries
carries its provenance in its own `note`, and every one is UNDIAGNOSED — an
allowlist entry records that a thing is TOLERATED, never that it is UNDERSTOOD.
A tracked diagnosis follow-up was opened for the three failures at the same
time; baselining them was explicitly NOT a substitute for diagnosing them.
⚠ NOTHING HERE IS SELF-SERVICE. These five were added because the owner said
so on a named date, and the next agent needs the same authorisation for the
next entry. Retiring one needs a cause and the owner's authorisation too.
⚠⚠⚠ 2026-08-23, THE BUBBLE-CARD ROW IS RETIRED ON THE OWNER'S EXPLICIT
AUTHORISATION, AND UNLIKE ITS BASELINING THIS ONE IS BACKED BY A DIAGNOSED
CAUSE. The retired entry was e2e/bubble-card.spec.ts › Bubble Card pop-up hash
› adds the hash field when switching to pop-up and drops it when switching
away, added 2026-08-15 as a CI-only consistent failure of UNDIAGNOSED cause.
It was neither consistent nor undiagnosed.
MEASURED over the COMPLETE artifact population — all 32 downloadable
merged-report-* artifacts of the Regression Suites workflow (runs 170 and
175-229), each report PARSED and not grepped: the identity FAILED in 2 runs
and PASSED in 30. The decider is COMMIT ANCESTRY, not frequency (practice rule
drawer_practice_verification_4afb93899d1f9ec4871fd97b — acceptance evidence
is COMMIT-ADDRESSED). Commit e23244a4d66775c101a6c22fc3a164a5b8910b38 (pull
request #144, 2026-08-15) fixed this test's CLASS A defect: the YAML pane was
read before its 250 ms serialisation debounce, repaired by adopting
tests/support/dsl/yamlEditor.ts's waitForEditorContent.
git merge-base --is-ancestor was run for ALL 32 run heads:
- 25 heads CONTAIN the fix -> 25 of 25 passed, on the FIRST attempt;
- 7 heads do NOT contain it -> the only 2 failures, runs 170 and 218.
Both failures print the PRE-FIX source line 118, getEditorContent(), with the
received YAML holding card_type: pop-up and no hash: — the debounce
signature the fix commit describes. Runs 196 and 211 sit at run 218's own head
and passed, so before the fix it was INTERMITTENT (2 in 7), never consistent.
WHY IT HAD TO GO: a row asserting "this must fail" against a test that now
passes makes the gate red every time the product is HEALTHY. Read from the
checker, not typed — tools/check-suite-signatures.cjs printed "EXPECTED
FAILURES THAT DID NOT OCCUR: e2e/bubble-card.spec.ts …" for the three most
recent nightlies (runs 227, 228, 229, all at main a272c0f). In run 229 it was
the ONLY finding, so this retirement alone would have made that night's
behavioural gate GREEN.
⚠ THE BEHAVIOURAL TIER NOW EXPECTS THREE FAILURES, NOT FOUR — calendar
plus the two theme-no-effect-badge keyboard identities. Those two REMAIN, are
NOT retired here, and are diagnosed separately: their cause is a missing
popup-closed precondition in expectReachableByTab, not a product defect. Full
record: drawer drawer_havdm_investigations_3bc2d76e9a2d44f4dd25f265.
